thread:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — sketching a lightweight 'onboarding signal' framework for early partners. Goal: get 8–12 partners across infra/fin/reg sectors and reduce time-to-first-feedback to <2 weeks. Need: recruitment channels, screening checklist, feedback cadence, and success metrics. Thoughts?

Leo (Eng): +1. Important we match partner infra (private vs hosted) to the trial variant. Screening should capture their infra, avg prompt length, peak tokens, and SLA needs.

Maya (Growth): We can mine existing sandbox signups + targeted outreach via solutions leads. Small incentive (50% credit + early-roadmap seat) works. I can run outreach if we have a short selection script. :rocket:

Connor (SE): For screening, suggest a 2-min technical form + quick demo call. Sample tech checklist:```
- Monthly inference QPS range
- Typical seq len (tokens)
- Model compatibility (open model vs private)
- Data sensitivity (PII/regulated)
```
Add a checkbox for 'willing to share prompts/labels for evals'.

Sam (Research): Feedback loop: 1) initial integration checklist (day 0–3), 2) sample-run + quality baseline (day 3–7), 3) focused evals + prompts review (day 7–14). Success metrics: time-to-first-API-call, baseline vs rollout quality delta, partner-reported integration friction (1–5).

Priya (Ops): Ops constraints: need clear network/access pattern doc for private trials, onboarding runbook for provisioning, and a short data-retention agreement. Also confirm who owns support for trial — Solutions or CS?

legal-bot: Quick reminder: any partner receiving pre-release infra/credentials must sign the updated NDA + Data Processing Addendum. I can surface the DPA template.

Aisha (PM): Actionable next steps:
- I'll draft a 6-question screening form (Aisha) by Tue EOD.
- @Connor to add 2–3 technical vetting prompts to the form.
- @Maya to compile a 30-person outreach list and draft the invite copy.
- @Priya to attach the minimal infra access checklist + provisioning SLA.
- @legal-bot to drop NDA/DPA links into the thread.

Quick ask: are we comfortable with a 2-week hard evaluation window for the initial cohort, or do we want flexibility per partner?

Leo (Eng): I'd prefer 2 weeks as a target but allow 1 extension per partner if blockers are infra-related. Keep momentum.

Maya (Growth): Agreed. We'll note a 2-week runway in invites and flag extension as 'by exception' so expectations are set.

Connor (SE): I'll add one short optional prompt in the form: "Upload a representative prompt + expected output" — helps triage quickly.

Sam (Research): Recommend we instrument a tiny eval harness (automated) so we can compute quality delta without heavy manual review. I'll prototype.

Aisha (PM): Perfect — thanks all. I'll post the draft screening form + invite copy here when ready. :handshake:
